definitions.gloss: the rings; still rings (men's gymnastics apparatus)
definitions.explanation: An apparatus in men's artistic gymnastics consisting of two rings hung from cables, on which the athlete performs swings, holds, and strength elements. Also the name of that event.

examples.japanese: つり{輪|わ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧。
つり{輪|わ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{金|きん}メダル→金メダル：20781_kinmedaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: He won the gold medal on the rings.

examples.japanese: つり{輪|わ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧⟦{男子|だんし}→男子：03425_danshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種目|しゅもく}→種目：27734_shumoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The rings is one of the men's artistic gymnastics events.

notes:
Formed from つり ("hanging," from {吊|つ}る, to suspend) + ⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧ (ring). The hanging element is usually written in kana.

GYMNASTICS CONTEXT:
- One of the six men's artistic gymnastics events
- Prizes both swinging skill and great upper-body strength (e.g., the iron-cross hold)
- Other apparatus include ⟦{鉄棒|てつぼう}→鉄棒：17912_tetsubou⟧ (horizontal bar) and {平行棒|へいこうぼう} (parallel bars)
